cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you to the station. You cover petrol and tell me why you stopped calling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover petrol. I'm not doing the other part in a car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, we can drive quietly. Name a day for the conversation before I start the engine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow. But you'll have to call me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Petrol today, then. Tomorrow you call first; I need to know you want the conversation as much as the lift.

reason: Make A yield conversation location while B deferral raises the emotional price from explaining silence to initiating wanted contact.
